meta.name: theme-factory
meta.description: Toolkit for styling artifacts with a theme. These artifacts can be slides, docs, reportings, HTML landing pages, etc. There are 10 pre-set themes with colors/fonts that you can apply to any artifact that has been creating, or can generate a new theme on-the-fly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为幻灯片、文档等作品一键套用或生成主题样式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为不同文档或演示统一配色和字体风格
copy.tagline_en: Apply or generate themes for slides, docs, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need consistent colors and fonts across documents and presentations

howto.what: 它给幻灯片、文档、报告、HTML 落地页等成品套上统一主题(配色加字体);内置 10 个预设主题,也可以按你给的描述现场生成一个新主题。
howto.when: 当你有已做好的幻灯片、文档等成品,想套用配色和字体主题时接管;它先展示主题总览,等你确认后再应用。

say.text: 给我这套幻灯片套一个主题
say.note: 它会先展示主题总览让你挑

say.text: 用 Ocean Depths 主题改这份文档
say.note: 它会应用该主题的配色与字体

say.text: 这些主题都不合适,帮我新建一个
say.note: 它会生成新主题并先给你确认

howto.what_en: It applies a theme -- colors and fonts -- to finished artifacts like slides, docs, reports, or HTML landing pages. There are 10 preset themes, and it can generate a new theme on the fly.
howto.when_en: Use it when you already have an artifact (slides, docs, etc.) and want consistent colors and fonts. It shows the theme showcase first, then applies the theme after you confirm.

say_en.text: Apply a theme to this slide deck
say_en.note: It shows the theme showcase first, then you pick

say_en.text: Restyle this doc with the Ocean Depths theme
say_en.note: It applies that theme's colors and fonts

say_en.text: None of these fit -- make me a new theme
say_en.note: It generates a theme and shows it for review
